 News On AIR | 
 October 26, 2026 2:03 PM 
 Andhra: Govt steps up precautionary measures, Official machinery put on high alert
 Cyclone Arnab has intensified over the Bay of Bengal and is expected to strengthen further before crossing the Andhra Pradesh coast on Wednesday. Heavy to extremely heavy rainfall is forecast in several coastal districts on Tuesday and Wednesday. The IMD has also warned of a possible rise in sea levels in low-lying coastal areas. 
 The Andhra Pradesh Government has stepped up precautionary measures. Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu has directed officials to remain on high alert, coordinate emergency operations and issue regular public warnings. Ten NDRF and eleven SDRF teams have been kept ready for rescue and relief work. 
 Fishermen have been advised not to venture into the sea. People in vulnerable coastal areas have been asked to follow official instructions and move to safer places whenever necessary. The electricity department has also been directed to keep staff and equipment ready to restore power quickly in the event of disruptions.
